questions.q: The true average spend of all 100,000 customers is 170.22, and the average of your sample of 200 is 180.31. Which term describes 180.31?
options: A parameter
A statistic
A population
A stratum
questions.explain: A number computed from a sample is a statistic. The population figure of 170.22 is the parameter.

questions.q: Five random samples of 200 customers give means from 159.2 to 180.3. What does this spread represent?
options: Sampling bias that must be removed
Evidence that the population mean is changing
Ordinary random sampling variability
A programming error in pandas
questions.explain: Different random samples naturally give different statistics. This random error has no systematic direction.

questions.q: A survey is answered only by customers with 6+ orders a year, and the estimate is 241.55 versus a true 170.22. What happens if you increase respondents from 2,000 to 20,000 from the same group?
options: The estimate will converge to the true mean
The estimate will still be biased, just more precisely
The estimate will drop below the true mean
The bias will cancel out
questions.explain: Bias comes from how the data was collected. More data from the same flawed process only reduces random noise, not the systematic tilt.

questions.q: Which is an example of survivorship bias?
options: Analyzing only customers who are still subscribed to judge satisfaction with the product
Randomly selecting 200 customers from a full customer list
Splitting customers by region before sampling
Simulating data with a fixed random seed
questions.explain: Looking only at those who stayed ignores those who left, who may have had very different experiences.

questions.q: What is the main advantage of stratified sampling by region?
options: It removes all randomness
It guarantees each region is represented in proportion
It works without a list of the population
It makes the sample larger
questions.explain: Sampling within each group keeps every group represented in proportion, which helps most when groups differ on the measured quantity.
